condition_schema: H0 TRAIN comprises the earlier catalog plus prior oracle-scored generated proposals, with 13332, 13546, and 13279 UMA TRAIN records for n_Li=12,24,36; each teacher uses own energies and shared identities/splits. implication: Fixed historical q20 LOW-tail success and H0 measured LOW-bin membership differ; thresholds must not be interchanged. The difference does not by itself establish why the populations differ.
